title: Review assertion on a DataLab capsule, version 1
description: A statement by a reviewer about one capsule revision, identified by its manifest fingerprint. It is a separate document: it never changes the capsule. Unknown properties are tolerated so that additive changes stay compatible.

target.description: Manifest fingerprint of the reviewed revision.

identifier.description: Optional persistent identifier, e.g. an ORCID IRI.

verdict.description: endorsed, disputed or comment; null when the reviewer states none.

reports.description: Verification reports the review relies on, summarised: activity and verdict.

review_fingerprint.description: Digest of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the review without this property.
